[[Second Spear Binah]] offers passage between [[Churrhir Fields]] and [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]].

== Locations ==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Churrhir Fields}}
** {{NPC location|Kamadan, Jewel of Istan}}

== Dialogue ==
Kamadan:
: ''"We've established a camp just outside Chahbek Village in Churrhir Fields. We hope to train new recruits there to help protect the village from further attacks when we rebuild."''
:: '''Can you take me to the Sunspear encampment in Churrhir Fields?'''
:: ''"Certainly. Let me know when you are ready."''
::: {{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (sent to Churrhir Fields)
::: {{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''
:: '''I'll be on my way.'''

Churrhir Fields:
: ''"Whenever you want to go back to Kamadan, just let me know."''
:: '''Can you take me to Kamadan?'''
:: ''"Certainly. Let me know when you are ready."''
::: {{yes|ingame}} '''We are ready.''' (sent to Kamadan)
::: {{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''
:: '''I'll be on my way.'''

Churrhir Fields, alternate:
(For Nightfall characters, if [[Honing your Skills]] is not active or complete.)
: ''"[[First Spear Dehvad]] still has more to teach [Character Name]. I can't let you into Kamadan until [Character Name] speaks to the First Spear again."''

== Notes ==
{{anomaly| Even though there is no associated quest, Binah has a [[quest giver|quest icon]] over her head while in Churrhir Fields.}}
